accepts-transfers.title: Accepts Transfers
accepts-transfers.description: Controls whether the server accepts incoming player transfers via transfer packets. When disabled, transfer attempts are rejected and the player is disconnected.

allow-flight.title: Allow Flight
allow-flight.description: Permits players to use flight in Survival mode (typically via mods). When disabled, players hovering for more than 5 seconds are kicked. Does not affect Creative mode flight.

allow-nether.title: Allow Nether
allow-nether.description: Controls whether Nether portals work and players can enter the Nether. Removed in 1.21.9 and replaced by the 'allowEnteringNetherUsingPortals' game rule.

broadcast-console-to-ops.title: Broadcast Console to Ops
broadcast-console-to-ops.description: Controls whether console command output is sent to all online operators.

broadcast-rcon-to-ops.title: Broadcast RCON to Ops
broadcast-rcon-to-ops.description: Controls whether RCON console command output is sent to all online operators.

bug-report-link.title: Bug Report Link
bug-report-link.description: A URL sent to clients for reporting bugs. If empty, no link is sent.

difficulty.title: Difficulty
difficulty.description: Sets the world difficulty level, which affects hunger depletion, mob damage, and other gameplay mechanics.

enable-command-block.title: Enable Command Blocks
enable-command-block.description: Controls whether command blocks are functional on the server. Removed in 1.21.9 and replaced by the 'enableCommandBlocks' game rule.

enable-jmx-monitoring.title: Enable JMX Monitoring
enable-jmx-monitoring.description: Exposes a JMX MBean with averageTickTime and tickTimes attributes for performance monitoring. Requires additional JVM flags to be configured.

enable-query.title: Enable Query
enable-query.description: Enables the GameSpy4 query protocol listener, allowing external tools to query server information.

enable-rcon.title: Enable RCON
enable-rcon.description: Enables remote console (RCON) access to the server. Not recommended over untrusted networks as the protocol is unencrypted.

enable-status.title: Enable Status
enable-status.description: Controls whether the server appears as 'online' in the server list. When disabled, the server appears offline but still accepts direct connections.

enforce-secure-profile.title: Enforce Secure Profile
enforce-secure-profile.description: When enabled, only players with a Mojang-signed public key can join. When disabled, chat messages are unsigned and clients may see a security warning.

enforce-whitelist.title: Enforce Whitelist
enforce-whitelist.description: When enabled, players not on the whitelist who are currently online get kicked when the whitelist is reloaded.

entity-broadcast-range-percentage.title: Entity Broadcast Range Percentage
entity-broadcast-range-percentage.description: Controls how close entities need to be before they are sent to clients, as a percentage of the default value. Higher values mean entities are visible from farther away at the cost of more bandwidth.

force-gamemode.title: Force Game Mode
force-gamemode.description: When enabled, forces players to join in the default game mode set by the 'gamemode' property. When disabled, players retain the game mode they had when they last left.

function-permission-level.title: Function Permission Level
function-permission-level.description: Sets the default permission level for functions. Level 1: bypass spawn protection. Level 2: use command blocks, change difficulty. Level 3: multiplayer management (/ban, /kick, /op). Level 4: all commands including /stop.

gamemode.title: Game Mode
gamemode.description: The default game mode for new players joining the server.

generate-structures.title: Generate Structures
generate-structures.description: Controls whether structures (villages, strongholds, temples, etc.) are generated during world creation. Dungeons generate regardless of this setting.

generator-settings.title: Generator Settings
generator-settings.description: JSON settings used to customize world generation. The format depends on the chosen level-type. Primarily used with flat worlds to define layers.

hardcore.title: Hardcore
hardcore.description: Enables hardcore mode. Players are set to Spectator mode on death and the difficulty is locked to Hard.

hide-online-players.title: Hide Online Players
hide-online-players.description: When enabled, the server does not send the player list in status responses, hiding player names and count from the server list.

initial-disabled-packs.title: Initial Disabled Packs
initial-disabled-packs.description: Comma-separated list of data packs to exclude from auto-enabling during initial world creation.

initial-enabled-packs.title: Initial Enabled Packs
initial-enabled-packs.description: Comma-separated list of data packs to auto-enable during initial world creation. Feature packs must be explicitly listed here to be enabled.

level-name.title: Level Name
level-name.description: The name of the world and its save directory. Can be a relative or absolute path.

level-seed.title: Level Seed
level-seed.description: The seed used for world generation. If left blank, a random seed is used. Only applies during initial world creation.

level-type.title: Level Type
level-type.description: The type of world to generate. Only applies during initial world creation.

log-ips.title: Log IPs
log-ips.description: Controls whether client IP addresses are shown in the server console and log files.

max-chained-neighbor-updates.title: Max Chained Neighbor Updates
max-chained-neighbor-updates.description: Limits the number of consecutive neighbor block updates before skipping additional ones. Helps prevent excessive lag from large redstone contraptions. Set to -1 to disable the limit.

max-players.title: Max Players
max-players.description: The maximum number of players that can be connected simultaneously. Operators with 'bypassesPlayerLimit' in ops.json can still join when full.

max-tick-time.title: Max Tick Time
max-tick-time.description: Maximum milliseconds a single server tick may take before the watchdog stops the server with a crash report. Set to -1 to disable the watchdog entirely.

max-world-size.title: Max World Size
max-world-size.description: The maximum radius (in blocks) from world center (0,0) where the world border can be set.

motd.title: MOTD
motd.description: The message displayed in the server list below the server name. Supports section-sign color codes and special characters.

network-compression-threshold.title: Network Compression Threshold
network-compression-threshold.description: Minimum packet size (in bytes) before compression is applied. Set to -1 to disable compression entirely. Set to 0 to compress all packets. Values below 64 are not recommended as they can increase packet size.

online-mode.title: Online Mode
online-mode.description: When enabled, the server verifies connecting players against the Mojang account database. Disabling allows any username to connect ('cracked' server) and is a security risk.

op-permission-level.title: Op Permission Level
op-permission-level.description: The default permission level for operators. Level 0: no permissions. Level 1: bypass spawn protection. Level 2: use command blocks, change difficulty. Level 3: multiplayer management (/ban, /kick, /op). Level 4: all commands including /stop.

pause-when-empty-seconds.title: Pause When Empty Seconds
pause-when-empty-seconds.description: Seconds after the last player disconnects before the server pauses ticking to save resources. Set to -1 to disable (server never pauses).

player-idle-timeout.title: Player Idle Timeout
player-idle-timeout.description: Minutes of player inactivity before they are kicked from the server. Set to 0 to disable idle kicks.

prevent-proxy-connections.title: Prevent Proxy Connections
prevent-proxy-connections.description: When enabled, kicks players whose ISP/AS differs from what the Mojang authentication server reports. Helps prevent proxy and VPN connections.

pvp.title: PvP
pvp.description: Controls whether players can deal damage to each other. Removed in 1.21.9 and replaced by the 'pvp' game rule.

query.port.title: Query Port
query.port.description: The UDP port the GameSpy4 query listener binds to. Only used when 'enable-query' is enabled.

rate-limit.title: Rate Limit
rate-limit.description: Maximum number of packets a player can send per second before being kicked. Set to 0 to disable the rate limit.

rcon.password.title: RCON Password
rcon.password.description: The password for RCON authentication. Must not be blank if RCON is enabled.

rcon.port.title: RCON Port
rcon.port.description: The TCP port the RCON listener binds to.

region-file-compression.title: Region File Compression
region-file-compression.description: The algorithm used to compress chunks in region files. 'deflate' has the best compression ratio. 'lz4' is faster but slightly less compressed. 'none' disables compression (larger disk usage).

require-resource-pack.title: Require Resource Pack
require-resource-pack.description: When enabled, players who decline the server resource pack are disconnected.

resource-pack.title: Resource Pack URL
resource-pack.description: URL to a resource pack that clients are prompted to download. Maximum file size is 250 MiB.

resource-pack-id.title: Resource Pack ID
resource-pack-id.description: An optional UUID to uniquely identify the resource pack with clients. Uses standard hyphenated hexadecimal format.

resource-pack-prompt.title: Resource Pack Prompt
resource-pack-prompt.description: Custom message shown on the resource pack download prompt dialog. Supports chat component JSON text formatting.

resource-pack-sha1.title: Resource Pack SHA-1
resource-pack-sha1.description: SHA-1 hash digest of the resource pack file (lowercase hexadecimal, 40 characters). Used for integrity verification.

server-ip.title: Server IP
server-ip.description: The IP address the server binds to. If blank, the server listens on all available network interfaces.

server-port.title: Server Port
server-port.description: The TCP port the server listens on for client connections.

simulation-distance.title: Simulation Distance
simulation-distance.description: The maximum distance from a player (in chunks) where living entities are ticked and gameplay mechanics are active. Lower values improve performance.

spawn-animals.title: Spawn Animals
spawn-animals.description: Controls whether passive mobs (animals) can spawn naturally. Removed in 1.21.2 due to a bug where disabling it removed all existing animals and prevented summoning new ones.

spawn-monsters.title: Spawn Monsters
spawn-monsters.description: Controls whether hostile mobs can spawn naturally. Removed in 1.21.9 and replaced by the 'spawnMonsters' game rule.

spawn-npcs.title: Spawn NPCs
spawn-npcs.description: Controls whether villagers (NPCs) can spawn naturally. Removed in 1.21.2 due to a bug where disabling it removed all existing villagers and prevented summoning new ones.

spawn-protection.title: Spawn Protection
spawn-protection.description: Radius of the spawn protection area in blocks. The protected area is a square of side length (2 * value + 1). Set to 0 to disable. Automatically disabled if only one operator exists.

sync-chunk-writes.title: Sync Chunk Writes
sync-chunk-writes.description: When enabled, chunk writes are synchronous, preventing potential data corruption at the cost of some write performance.

text-filtering-config.title: Text Filtering Config
text-filtering-config.description: Configuration for the chat text filtering mechanism. Primarily used internally by Minecraft Realms.

text-filtering-version.title: Text Filtering Version
text-filtering-version.description: Version of the configuration format used by text-filtering-config.

use-native-transport.title: Use Native Transport
use-native-transport.description: When enabled, uses optimized packet sending/receiving on Linux (epoll). Has no effect on other operating systems.

view-distance.title: View Distance
view-distance.description: The radius (in chunks) of world data sent to clients. Higher values allow players to see farther but increase bandwidth and memory usage.

white-list.title: Whitelist
white-list.description: When enabled, only players listed in whitelist.json can join the server. Operators are automatically whitelisted.
